checks: Replayed 179 complete raw polls to the same seven published segments and 162 events.
Verified each reviewed endpoint against complete original poll payloads and source prediction identities.
Checked matching line, direction, vehicle, trip and eight-stop order; positive travel duration.
Checked at least two source times, last source gap at most 90 seconds, ETA adjustment at most 120 seconds, near-stop countdown at most 60 seconds and fresh source clocks.
Checked two successful, healthy and distinct post-ETA absence frames with advancing source times and at least 20 seconds separation.
limitations: Agent review of recorded TfL prediction evidence only. No human signoff, independently measured arrival, calibrated probability or database-snapshot audit is claimed.
